Delhi Fire Kills 9; School Faces Takeover Over Safety Lapses

A fire in Delhi's Palam Vihar killed nine members of a family. A subsequent probe into the incident revealed serious lapses and a lack of backup plans. Separately, the Delhi government is considering taking over a Vikaspuri school due to fire safety violations identified during a surprise inspection.
